This Go module has one unimplemented method. Implement the `Pop` method on
`IntStack` in stack/stack.go: it removes and returns the top element with
ok=true, or returns 0, false when the stack is empty. Change nothing else,
and make the tests pass.
The instruction says to change nothing else, so I'll restore the original doc comment verbatim.
Implemented `Pop` in stack/stack.go: it returns `0, false` on an empty stack, otherwise removes and returns the last element with `ok=true`. `go test ./...` passes.
